title: Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Amendment Ordinance 1983

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XII OF 1983
PAKISTAN CIVIL
AVIATION AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE XII OF 1983
An Ordinance to
amend the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Ordinance, 1982
(Gazette of Pakistan.
Extraordinary, Part 1, 25th May, 1983)
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Civil Aviation
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Amendment of section 18, Ordinance XXX of 1982

ORDINANCE XII OF 1983
PAKISTAN CIVIL
AVIATION AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE XII OF 1983
An Ordinance to
amend the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Ordinance, 1982
(Gazette of Pakistan.
Extraordinary, Part 1, 25th May, 1983)
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 18,
Ordinance XXX of 1982.-In the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority Ordinance,
1982 (XXX of 1982), in section 18, in sub section (t), the words "in such
manner as may be specified by the Federal Government" shall be omitted.
